verdict.rationale: CRA documents EFILE as a sanctioned system-to-system transmitter channel: preparers transmit returns directly from CRA-certified software after the developer completes a compatibility process with CRA, and filers hold an EFILE number and password to maintain or renew the account and view transmission history. The agency's own EFILE page carries the enrollment path, and ReFILE extends the channel to amended T1 returns. Missing for 10: the enrollment steps themselves are only summarized rather than quoted, there is no evidence of transmitter or batch channels beyond T1 EFILE/ReFILE (e.g., business or payroll bulk filing), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
